sloka: मुदा परमया युक्तो विश्रवा मुनिपुङ्गवः ।स तस्यां वीर्यसम्पन्नमपत्यं परमाद्भुतम् ।। ७.३.५ ॥
transliteration: mudā paramayā yukto viśravā munipuṅgavaḥ ।sa tasyāṁ vīryasampannamapatyaṁ paramādbhutam ।। 7.3.5 ॥

translations.english: The foremost sage Vishrava, filled with supreme joy, begot in her an exceedingly wonderful offspring endowed with great valor.
